terms.gloss: and no wonder; it is not surprising
terms.comment: Said after the fact it explains. Also nīl mīrum (Cic. Att. 16.1.3) and quid mīrum? (Cic. Div. 2.81).

phrases.latin: accēpī tuam epistulam vacillantibus litterulīs, nec mīrum tam gravī morbō.
phrases.english: I have had your letter in shaky handwriting, and no wonder, after so serious an illness.
the seven wonders of the world
